## 🎯 Pull Request Summary

### 1. Linked Agile Task
Fixes/Implements: #[issue-number]
Sprint: [Sprint-XX]

### 2. Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 New Feature
- [ ] 🐛 Bug Fix
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring / Clean Architecture Enhancement
- [ ] 🔒 Security & Vulnerability Patch
- [ ] ⚙️ DevOps & CI/CD Pipeline Update

### 3. DevOps 8-Stage Compliance Checklist
- [ ] **Stage 2 (Code)**: Follows Clean Architecture, TypeScript/C# linting passed.
- [ ] **Stage 3 (Build)**: Compiles cleanly with zero build warnings.
- [ ] **Stage 4 (Test)**: Unit and integration tests added with >= 80% coverage.
- [ ] **Stage 5 (Release)**: Conventional commit messages (SemVer format).
- [ ] **Stage 6 (Deploy)**: K8s manifests & Docker container definitions updated if applicable.
- [ ] **Stage 7 (Operate)**: Health probe endpoints verified.
- [ ] **Stage 8 (Monitor)**: Prometheus metric scrapers and logging intact.
